1981-82 recession; both legs on in the same month; deepest pre-2008 rise
Scare: one week at +25.1% (week ending 1984-11-03), just over the threshold; cause not identified

1990-91 recession; both legs on in the same month (3 months after the NBER peak); slow 'jobless' recovery
2001 recession; claims led the unemployment leg by 7 months and the NBER peak by 4 months
Scare (Troy's ruling 2026-11-08): the late tail of the 2001 'jobless recovery'; unemployment peaked at 6.3% in June 2003
Scare: Hurricanes Katrina and Rita (Aug-Sep 2005); one week over +25%
